• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5

water.signature.ice_tomb.title: Ice Tomb

• Erudition ≥ 5

water.signature.summon_polar_bear.title: Summon Polar Bear

water.signature.legendary_blizzard.title: Blizzard

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5

water.signature.focused_ice_cone.title: Focused Ice Cone
water.signature.focused_ice_cone.description:

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 4
• Erudition ≥ 3

water.signature.giant_snowball.title: Giant Snowball
water.signature.giant_snowball.description:

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5

water.signature.ice_explosion_cone.title: Ice Explosion Cone
water.signature.ice_explosion_cone.description:

• Arcane Power ≥ 4
• Erudition ≥ 3

water.signature.living_ice_sculpture.title: Living Ice Sculpture
water.signature.living_ice_sculpture.description:
Create a zone where ice sculptures naturally form. The sculptures won't die naturally and have high health. After a certain time, the sculptures shatter and emit fragments, while spawning an ice sculpture creature at each sculpture's location. Ice sculpture creatures are summons that protect the caster and attack hostile entities.

• Erudition ≥ 5

blood.signature.blood_needles.title: Blood Needles
blood.signature.blood_needles.description:

blood.signature.blood_step.description:

• Arcane Power ≥ 4
• Erudition ≥ 3

blood.signature.devour.title: Devour
blood.signature.devour.description:

Requirements:

• Erudition ≥ 3

blood.signature.heartstop.title: Heartstop
blood.signature.heartstop.description:

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 4
• Erudition ≥ 3

blood.signature.raise_dead.title: Raise Dead
blood.signature.raise_dead.description:
Cast to summon undead minions from the earth beneath you. The higher the power, the better equipment they will have.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5
• Tracking ≥ 3

blood.signature.ray_of_siphoning.title: Ray Of Siphoning
blood.signature.ray_of_siphoning.description:
Hold to cast a ray of necrotic energy that siphons health from creatures it hits, damaging them and healing you for 100% of damage done.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5

blood.signature.wither_skull.title: Wither Skull
blood.signature.wither_skull.description:
Launch a wither skull forward that explodes in a small radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5

blood.signature.sacrifice.title: Sacrifice
blood.signature.sacrifice.description:
Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5

blood.signature.crimson_downpour.title: Crimson Downpour
blood.signature.crimson_downpour.description:
A blood rain that damages all enemies within for 7sec, lifestealing 12% of the damage dealt. Everyone caught in the rain are afflicted with Hemorrhage, reducing their holy resistance and amplifying spell power at the cost of losing health with each spell cast.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 4
• Erudition ≥ 3

blood.signature.call_forth_the_dead_king.title: Call Forth The Dead King
blood.signature.call_forth_the_dead_king.description:
Summons an Enraged Dead King boss to challenge you. Defeating it grants a higher chance of obtaining high-quality loot, including the exclusive spell Blackout. The Enraged Dead King can cast additional powerful spells.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5

blood.signature.resurrection_rune.title: Resurrection Rune
blood.signature.resurrection_rune.description:
Create a zone centered on yourself that turns the ground into a cradle of undeath. All creatures that die within this zone will be converted into undead. Spell power affects range, duration, and undead attributes.

• Erudition ≥ 5

• Keen Senses ≥ 1

ender.signature.starfall.description:
Target a single area and continuously rain down arcane comets from above for the duration of the spell

Requirements:

• Erudition ≥ 3
• Keen Senses ≥ 3

ender.signature.recall.title: Recall
ender.signature.recall.description:
Warps you back to your spawn location, or world spawn if there is none.

ender.signature.portal.description:

ender.signature.evasion.title: Evasion
ender.signature.evasion.description:
Cast to imbue yourself with ender energy. Upon being attacked while under its effects, you will immediately teleport within a short radius and avoid taking any damage. Only a finite amount of hits can be dodged before the effect immediately wears off.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 4
• Erudition ≥ 3
• Agility ≥ 3

ender.signature.shadow_slash.title: Shadow Slash
ender.signature.shadow_slash.description:
Dash forward with a arcing slash of arcane energy, striking creatures in an area. Projectiles hit are deflected. Scales off held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 4
• Erudition ≥ 3
• Precision ≥ 3

ender.signature.echoing_strikes.title: Echoing Strikes
ender.signature.echoing_strikes.description:
While under the effects of the spell, non-magical attacks will leave an echo of ender energy behind, shortly thereafter exploding with an echo of the original attack's damage.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 4
• Erudition ≥ 3
• Keen Senses ≥ 3

ender.signature.dragon_breath.title: Dragon Breath
ender.signature.dragon_breath.description:
Hold to spew a cone of dragon breath forwards. Each time a creature is hit, there is a chance to create a pool of dragon breath at their feet.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5
• Keen Senses ≥ 5

ender.signature.black_hole.title: Black Hole
ender.signature.black_hole.description:
Around a targeted location, create a fissure into the void, manifesting a black hole that will suck in nearby creatures and slowly crush them to death

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5
• Keen Senses ≥ 5

ender.signature.summon_swords.title: Summon Swords
ender.signature.summon_swords.description:
Conjure a trio of spectral armaments to aid in battle: a brawling shortsword, a quick rapier, and a tanking claymore. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Hazentouvel.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5
• Tracking ≥ 5

ender.signature.counterspell.title: Counterspell
ender.signature.counterspell.description:
Cast to interrupt any targeted magical process, such as a casting creature or a magical projectile.

Requirements:

ender.signature.astral_sense.title: Astral Sense
ender.signature.astral_sense.description:

evocation.signature.spectral_hammer.title: Spectral Hammer

• Tracking ≥ 3

evocation.signature.summon_horse.title: Summon Horse

evocation.signature.chain_creeper.title: Chain Creeper

Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. Any creature killed by this blast will conjure another, smaller, ring of creeper heads. This can chain multiple times.

evocation.signature.lob_creeper.title: Lob Creeper

evocation.signature.arcane_shackle.description:

• Tracking ≥ 5

evocation.signature.lingering_strain.title: Lingering Strain
evocation.signature.lingering_strain.description:
Grants a effect; During that any burst damage you get will be split into 4 different smaller damage and will be dealt over time giving the caster time to recover.

Requirements:

• Erudition ≥ 3
• Erudition ≥ 3

evocation.signature.creeper_revenge.title: Creeper Revenge
evocation.signature.creeper_revenge.description:
The creeper tryna steal my stuff again

• Tracking ≥ 5

evocation.signature.shotgun_creeper.title: Shotgun Creeper
evocation.signature.shotgun_creeper.description:

evocation.signature.elemental_burst.title: Elemental Burst
evocation.signature.elemental_burst.description:
Release the power of elements, rotating between §cFire§r, §bIce§r, and §9Lightning§r damage. Each element's damage is calculated separately with its corresponding school spell power bonus. Fire causes burning, Ice causes slowness, Lightning causes weakness.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5
• Intimidation ≥ 5

evocation.signature.magic_shotgun.title: Magic Shotgun
evocation.signature.magic_shotgun.description:
Infuse mana into your weapon and release it through melee attacks. §cCost§r: Loses element reactions and partial spell power. §nTwo-stage casting§r: First cast gains buff, second cast removes buff. During buff duration, spells won't release after casting but trigger on melee attacks.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 6
• Erudition ≥ 5
• Tracking ≥ 5

eldritch.signature.pocket_dimension.title: Pocket Dimension

• Keen Senses ≥ 5

eldritch.signature.blackout.title: Blackout
eldritch.signature.blackout.description:
Creates a lingering anti-magic field that suppresses abilities within its radius. Players caught in the zone are unable to cast spells, use items, or place blocks. Moving within the field inflicts damage. Can only be obtained by defeating the Enraged Dead King.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 2
• Erudition ≥ 2
• Willpower ≥ 1

eldritch.signature.psychic_bolt.title: Psychic Bolt
eldritch.signature.psychic_bolt.description:
Select multiple targets on cast. On recast end, fires small projectiles that confuse targets on hit, making them prioritize attacking nearby non-player entities.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 4
• Erudition ≥ 3
• Willpower ≥ 3

eldritch.signature.spectral_blink.title: Spectral Blink
eldritch.signature.spectral_blink.description:
After activation, the caster has 3 seconds. During this time, they can teleport to any entity they are looking at, even through walls. Any entities within the teleportation range will be revealed to the caster.

Requirements:
• Arcane Power ≥ 4
• Erudition ≥ 3
• Agility ≥ 3

eldritch.signature.reversal.title: Reversal
eldritch.signature.reversal.description:
Reverses any incoming damage with increased power. Additionally, it can copy incoming projectiles.

eldritch.signature.void_tentacles.title: Void Tentacles
